scope: Submission working tree; no new experiment training/evaluation/deployment

.dvc.decision: Retain DVC ownership/configuration; installed cache and config.local excluded. Bundled distribution copy retained separately under reproducibility/.

artifacts.decision: Retain DVC pointers and restored objects; object binaries excluded from Git.

data.decision: Retain provenance and DVC pointers; restored datasets excluded from Git.

deploy.decision: Retain Docker image pins, runtime locks, release/rollback and KServe configurations.

docs.decision: Retain exactly five required PDFs and five matching Markdown sources.

evidence.decision: Retain all supplied screenshots and distinct CI/worker/KServe records.

frontend.decision: Retain source/configuration/lockfile; installed dependencies ignored and build output removed.

monitoring.decision: Retain exporters, scrape/alert configs and provisioned Grafana assets.

reports.decision: Retain compact measured component/lifecycle outcomes and fresh submission audit/tests.

scripts.decision: Retain reproducible experiment, serving, verification and documentation commands.

src.decision: Retain application implementation; generated Python caches removed.

tests.decision: Retain all 41 existing cases; generated caches removed.

state.decision: Live local databases/tracking/application state preserved and excluded from Git.

.git.decision: Real Git history retained; this directory is not source-upload content.

reproducibility.decision: Retain the small checksum-verified DVC distribution archive for repo-link-only restoration.

distribution_note: Repository includes reproducibility/dvc-store.tar.gz and scripts/restore_submission.py. A clone can restore data/model objects without another download link. Dependencies/base images still need installation; live accounts/history and historical MLflow tracking state are initialized separately.
experiment_report_scope: Completed implementation, methods, workflows and measured results only.
